items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: the man who used to lead the band, his name was Effie Jones.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Uh huh. Uh huh. Uh huh. Who, who's band was in down there in Magnolia?

Well, what, the band, the band was named the Magnolia, Magnolia, Magnolia, Magnolia, Brass Band. Well, that's the name they had, Magnolia, Brass Band, but the man who used to lead the band, his name was Effie Jones.
